mod.name: Video Vixen Career Mod
mod.author: Your Sim Modding Studio
mod.description:
A complete career mod for The Sims 4 featuring the Video Vixen profession. Rise from an aspiring content creator to a legend of digital media!
Features: - 10 unique career levels - Progressive salary growth from $300 to $7,000 per day - Custom career tasks and objectives - Skill requirements that unlock as you progress - Full integration with The Sims 4 career system
